title: AAPS client Sync button does not work 3.3.0-dev-c
symptom: In AAPSClient, the synchronization settings for appsclient cannot be accessed or edited. The option can be found via a search of preferences, but it is not clickable and cannot be edited.
cause: The thread indicates that these settings should not be accessible in AAPSClient at all. In current AAPSClient master, they can be opened and changed, which can cause issues. In dev, the option appears in search but cannot be clicked, which is considered a bug because it should not appear in search either.
fix: The thread does not provide a fix, but it suggests that the settings should not appear in search or be accessible in AAPSClient. The maintainer MilosKozak is investigating the bug.
evidence_quote: This has never been possible in AAPSClient if you are talking about the NSclient > Sync option available in AAPS.
